csv_project_name: Architectural Svc for Roebling Machine Shop Exterior Rehab
csv_scope_of_work: RFP for ADDITIONAL ARCHITECTUAL CONSTRUCTION PHASE SERVICES FOR THE COMPLETION OF ROEBLING MACHINE SHOP EXTERIOR REHABILITATION LOCATED AT 675 SOUTH CLINTON AVENUE, TRENTON, NJ. The Proposer shall provide all construction phase architectural services necessary to support the City in administering the remaining construction of the Roebling Machine Shop Exterior Rehabilitation through completion and close-out. The Proposer shall assemble a team that includes, as necessary, structural and electrical engineering support to address the structural and electrical (egress, fire alarm, emergency lighting, and signage) elements of the work.
